item.title: Precious metals slammed, silver plummeted. Was it this news out of China?
item.description: I think the moves were just the new volatility in fearful, thin markets. But, if you want some news, this earlier:China's gold consumption in 2025 fell 3.57% to 950.096 metric tons, the state-backed gold association said on Thursday. Gold output using domestic raw materials climbed 1.09% year on year to 381.339 metric tons, the association said. This article was written by Eamonn Sheridan at investinglive.com.
